subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Which Anthropic signed-thinking replay policy should be canonical for the remaining fix: the narrow completed-turn replay suppression in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383, the broader session-history sanitizer direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100149, or another split across prevention and recovery PRs?
rationale: Current source still replays provider-owned signed thinking for thinking-enabled Anthropic paths, and the competing open PRs affect provider compatibility, session state, and message delivery rather than a purely mechanical cleanup.

options.title: Review the narrow prevention PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as the canonical path for completed-turn native Anthropic replay and keep broader sanitizer work separate unless it proves an uncovered case.

options.title: Adopt the broader sanitizer
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100149 if maintainers want a generic non-latest signature-stripping policy despite its wider compatibility surface and current proof gap.

options.title: Split prevention and recovery carriers
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide which prevention PR lands and whether terminal-result recovery from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94649 is still needed afterward.

recommendation.title: Review the narrow prevention PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as the canonical path for completed-turn native Anthropic replay and keep broader sanitizer work separate unless it proves an uncovered case.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source ownership and issue comments make this the best available routing candidate for the replay-policy decision.
